items.title: The Long Table
items.alt: A long dinner table set on a lawn at dusk beneath trees
items.blurb: One table, one evening, no centrepiece taller than a glass. Timber, linen and candlelight did the rest.

items.title: Ceremony on the Lawn
items.alt: Rows of white chairs facing a floral arch across a lawn
items.blurb: An aisle of white blooms, a quiet frame and chairs that disappeared into the grass.

items.title: White & Gold Reception
items.alt: White and gold chairs beneath ceilings of draped fabric
items.blurb: Draped ceilings, gilded chairs and ivory linen, kept calm by restraint.

items.title: Candlelit Supper
items.alt: A long table with a draped runner lit by many candles
items.blurb: A long table lit only by candles, for a launch that needed warmth more than spectacle.
